_comment: Synthetic formal probate petition case. Demonstrates the multi-party fill pattern: applicant (petitioner), appointee (proposed PR — same person here, but split into two fields), decedent, attorney, and notary. This is the testate-side counterpart to DE-101's intestate case.

appointee_record._note: appointee == applicant in this case; the form has separate fields so both must be filled

notary_record._note: Notary fields are filled at the time of signing. The notary commission and identity are not pre-populated from a record but captured at the notarial appearance.

venue._note: Decedent domiciled in Sagadahoc County — straightforward venue under § 3-201

will_posture.will_details: Will dated 2018-09-14, two-page typed, witnessed by Lawrence Reed and Susan Maddox. No codicils.
will_posture._note: Margaret nominated as PR in the will — straight § 3-401 testate path

appointment_sought._note: Common pattern: applicant nominates herself (the will's named PR) for appointment

special_admin._note: Standard formal probate; no § 3-614 special administrator needed

relationships.other_heirs: None — decedent's spouse Helen R. Crawford predeceased him in 2019; no other children

_what_this_exercises: Five distinct parties: applicant, appointee, decedent, attorney, notary (each with its own *_record block)
applicant == appointee special case (most common — petitioner self-nominates), where same-person info goes into TWO different field groups
Formal probate path (DE-301) vs informal (DE-101) — applicant_signature_name field is separate from applicant_full_legal_name and must equals_field match (relaxed)
Yes/no narrative chain: domiciled_in_county → will_presented_for_probate → nominated_as_pr_in_will (all true → minimal-friction testate path)
Notary fields filled at signing, not from a stored record — pipeline must coordinate with notarial appearance
Validators encoded: equals_field(applicant_full_legal_name, relaxed) on applicant_signature_name AND notary_appearer_name; date_order(date_of_death, >) on applicant_signature_date
